# Intent (trimmed fixture: hal2's 2026-10-06 rows, skills plan 0012)

| Date | Question | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-06 | Does a red landing keep the merge queue? | Yes (the user, via the farmer 12-52: "no, i dont want to release it. i only want to release it, when the servants branch is merged into main. so everything needs to be fixed. else, we will never finish something. run landing until everything is fixed and merged and then release."). A red land run always finishes whole ("we said, that the whole workflow should finish and then all errors at once will be fixed", 12-51), merge-to-main ends with exit 4 `gate_failed` and the queue stays held for the worktree until its branch lands (or a stop, or the user's release); the rerun adopts the hold. Rule: [landings-on-github-actions](.adr/landings-on-github-actions.md) #4; plan 0131. Supersedes "a red candidate releases the merge queue at once" of "Where do a landing's gates run". |
| 2026-10-06 | Do the Swift apps (hal2-macos, hal2-ios) and their libraries go on? | **No: all Swift functionality is abandoned** (the user via the farmer 04-6: "all functionality regarding swift (macos and ios) are now abandoned"). The Swift code stays in the repository as the reference, unbuilt; no new Swift work, no UI test runs owed (plan 0094 step 7 dropped). Turning the Swift gate jobs off waits for worktree 04's cleanup train ("diabling swift should only happen after 04's train has arrived"): that train still runs them. The desktop app goes on as `hal9k-desktop` ([desktop-ui-electron](.adr/desktop-ui-electron.md)). |
| 2026-10-06 | How are the finished worktrees cleaned up? | **One cleanup train led by worktree 04, landed right after 12; then every worktree > 09 is deleted** (the user via the farmer 04-6, 04-7: "i want 06, 08 and 04 to be merged to main after 12. one train, 04 should take the lead"; "04 should also take everything else which is done and not part of 00 and 02 into its train, so that we can delete all worktrees > 09. this step should happen before 00 or 02 start merging"; "yes, 11 into 04 train"). The train `04-train` (merged into 04) carries 04, 06, 08, 11, 16, 20 and 22; their branches stay on origin, the passengers neither commit nor land, and 04 fixes their reds. Order: 12 → the train → 02's plan 0146 → 00's trains. 09 (plan 0147, Dependabot PRs) boards late (the user via the farmer 04-12: "also, i want 09 to finish now, when its done before the 04-train workflow finishes, it should be part of the train"): merged in only before a reland, never by cancelling a run going green; otherwise 09 lands after the train. Plan 0085's steps 7-8 (the quiet-Mac baseline and its report) are not part of it: a later task in a slot < 10. |
